args.command: echo '=== TERMINALS ==='; for x in xterm uxterm xfce4-terminal lxterminal mate-terminal gnome-terminal alacritty kitty foot konsole terminator; do p=$(command -v "$x" 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$p" ] && echo "$x=$p"; done; echo '=== PYTHON TUI ==='; python3 -c 'import curses; print("curses=YES")' 2>/dev/null || echo curses=NO; python3 -c 'import rich; print("rich=YES", rich.__version__ if hasattr(rich,"__version__") else "")' 2>/dev/null || echo rich=NO; python3 -c 'import textual; print("textual=YES", textual.__version__)' 2>/dev/null || echo textual=NO; python3 -c 'import prompt_toolkit; print("prompt_toolkit=YES", prompt_toolkit.__version__)' 2>/dev/null || echo prompt_toolkit=NO; echo '=== TMUX ==='; command -v tmux || true; echo '=== TERMINFO ==='; infocmp xterm-256color >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo xterm-256color=YES || echo xterm-256color=NO

meta.summary: Read-only probe terminal and Python TUI capabilities for CLI-first Living Workspace
